hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in */dist/*|*/node_modules/*|*/.prisma/*|*/generated/*) printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Generated/built artifact (%s) — do not edit by hand; change the source and regenerate."}' "$FILE"; exit 0;; esac; exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) if [ -x apps/server/node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then (cd apps/server && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1); fi;; esac; exit 0
